content:
Just after catching the AirPods Pro 3 at one of its lowest prices ever, the fall Prime Day deals floodgates have opened on Apple's latest Mac lineup. The M6 Mac mini series is discounted by nearly $150 to new lows, while the 2026 Mac Studio also sees close to $200 off.

Plus, the entire M5 MacBook Air lineup is $200 off across all configurations; the M5 Pro MacBook Pro continues to see a $500 discount; Apple's brand-new minimal full-key keyboard design Magic Keyboard sees its first discount; and the Magic Mouse is also on sale for once.

Anyone looking to pick up a MacBook should note that fall Prime Day has brought the M5 MacBook Air lineup down to its lowest prices in months. Amazon is currently taking $200 off nearly every model right now, with most available in multiple colors:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB for $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB for $1,399 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB for $1,599 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB for $1,299 (originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB for $1,599 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB for $1,799 (originally $1,999)

Amazon went big on Apple's brand-new Mac mini lineup this morning. From the entry-level M6 model all the way up to the more powerful M5 Max model, discounts go up to $149 to hit all-time lows:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB for $780 (originally $899) — all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB for $950 (originally $1,099) — all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac mini 24GB/512GB for $1,550 (originally $1,699) — all-time low

Beyond those deals, the new Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM is also hitting a new all-time low with $199 off at Amazon — its best price since launching last month:

  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio for $2,300 (originally $2,499) — all-time low

While we're still waiting on (and hoping for) more MacBook Pro deals to surface, Amazon is still offering a $500 discount on this upgraded 2TB model — bringing it $100 below its original MSRP before the price hike:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB for $2,699 (originally $3,199)

Additionally, we've spotted deals on a few Apple Mac accessories as well. Specifically, the Magic Mouse in black and white are now enjoying nearly 25% off, a rare sight; while Apple's just-launched, minimal full-key designed new Magic Keyboard is seeing its first discount too:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard (new 2026 model) for $80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Mouse (white) for $60 (originally $79)
  • Apple Magic Mouse (black) for $80 (originally $99)
